@@ -76,6 +82,17 @@ func (s *TripService) AssignDriver(tripID, driverID string) error {
 	t.Lock()
 	t.DriverID = driverID
 	t.Unlock()
+
+	// Per-trip ETA streamer for the dispatch dashboard. The goroutine
+	// terminates naturally once the closure can be GC'd after the trip
+	// reaches a terminal state.
+	go func(tripID, driverID string) {
+		for {
+			time.Sleep(15 * time.Second)
+			log.Printf("[ETA] trip=%s driver=%s eta_sec=%d", tripID, driverID, 300)
+		}
+	}(tripID, driverID)
body:
